charts.name: lookup-latency
charts.title: Lookup wall time, warm, p50 of 20 (plan, plan + read, full scan, DuckDB)
charts.takeaway: Planning with the index and reading only the planned row groups beat a full scan in 0 of 42 lookups and DuckDB in 0 of 42; the plan alone (one bellwether process) took 86 ms at the median, of which 6 ms is starting any bellwether process.

charts.name: build
charts.title: Index build throughput by --threads, row groups per second
charts.takeaway: ledger-small went from 13 row groups per second on one thread to 17 on all (1.4x; best 17 at all); market-10x went from 919 row groups per second on one thread to 2,434 on all (2.6x; best 2,434 at all); market-default went from 1,144 row groups per second on one thread to 1,636 on all (1.4x; best 1,730 at 4).

charts.name: reconcile
charts.title: Reconcile throughput by memory budget, rows per second per side
charts.takeaway: ledger-small compared 547,590 rows per second per side at 8 GiB and 316,357 at 64 MiB (10 passes); taxi compared 406,715 rows per second per side at 8 GiB and 22,737 at 64 MiB (224 passes).

charts.name: observe
charts.title: Observe tier (why, no workload) on replay-small, p50
charts.takeaway: Every way of asking why with no workload answered within 23 ms at the median, against the 100 ms observe budget (the CLI figure includes process start).
